prompt: A colossal, bipedal police robot towering over a rainy Tokyo street. The robot is constructed from heavy industrial machinery parts, featuring exposed gears, hydraulic pistons, and thick black cables connecting segmented white armor plates. It has no human face; instead, its head is a rectangular sensor array with multiple camera lenses. Red emergency lights flash on its shoulders and chest. The text "警視庁 MPD" (Metropolitan Police Department) is stenciled in black on the white armor plating of its torso and thighs. In the foreground, wet asphalt reflects the red and blue lights of surrounding police cars and traffic signals. Several small human police officers in dark tactical gear stand near the robot's feet, emphasizing its massive scale. A blue road sign indicating directions to "Tokyo Sta." and "Ginza" is visible on the right. A helicopter hovers in the grey, overcast sky above.

promptZh: 一台巨大的双足警用机器人矗立在雨中的东京街头，身形高耸入云。它由重型工业机械部件拼装而成，裸露的齿轮、液压活塞清晰可见，粗黑的线缆将分节式的白色装甲板串联在一起。它没有人类的面孔，头部取而代之的是一个矩形传感器阵列，上面密布着多个摄像头镜头。双肩与胸前的红色警示灯不停闪烁。躯干和大腿的白色装甲板上，用黑色模板喷涂着“警視庁 MPD”（东京警视厅）字样。前景中，湿漉漉的柏油路面倒映着周围警车与交通信号灯的蓝红光芒。几名身穿深色战术装备的人类警察站在机器人脚边，身形显得格外渺小，愈发衬托出它的庞大体量。右侧立着一块蓝色路牌，标示着通往“Tokyo Sta.”（东京站）和“Ginza”（银座）的方向。灰蒙蒙的阴沉天空中，一架直升机正在盘旋。
